name: The Greenwood Compact
seat: the innermost grove (location unwritten; strangers do not return from attempts)
summary: The greenfolk realm: the whole Greenwood constituted as a single ancient treaty — the Compact of Five Roots, sworn with Veyra in the Age of Stone. The Root-Wardens speak for the forest; the forest, slowly, speaks for itself. The Compact has held for ~2,700 years and is fraying.

government.title: Root-Wardens (council)
government.note: No single head. Decisions take seasons; vows take generations. The Wardens' vow of non-interference in mortal wars has held 800 years and is under strain.

laws: The Compact of Five Roots is the constitution: the green stands while the world stands; harmers of green answer to it. The Glimmer is 'the sickness' — a greenfolk who takes it suffers the first, forbidden exile.

relations.note: Root against shaft, managed by treaty.
Greenfolk tend Wealdmark orchards; loggers stay out of the Greenwood.
Field-priests serve human farmland; grove-priests serve the realm.

history_notes: Constituted ~1,100 AS with Veyra's vow — the oldest living treaty on Aurelith.
Glimmer-sickness in crops near the Quiet's edge has the Wardens asking questions of the Eldertree that it does not answer.
adventure_hooks: A Warden breaks non-interference to beg players' help against something eating the deep grove.
Players witness a Glimmerborn greenfolk's exile — and are asked to guide the exile somewhere safe.
The Compact's founding terms mention a fifth root that is not a tree; finding what it meant reopens the treaty.
